step_by_step_reasoning: The architecture diagram shows an in-game purchase recommendation system (ML Offer) split into online inference and offline training pipelines. Online inference consists of AWS Lambda acting as a reverse proxy/traffic allocator, routing requests to model containers (m1, m2, m3) and a Multi-Armed Bandit (MAB) container running in Amazon ECS. Kafka streams user feedback data to MAB to recount weights, which feeds back to Lambda. The training workflow is managed by Airflow on Amazon EC2, triggering Amazon SageMaker to collect training data from Kafka and output trained model artifacts to Amazon S3. Amazon S3 and Amazon ECR supply the model artifacts and container images respectively to the ECS cluster.
